provenance.construction: Degree-one r=1 graft of the [[563,18,20]] tile code
provenance.notes: Checked against the board: no exact-duplicate or WL-equivalent entry (trusted gate). REVISED 2026-09-20: distance corrected from d=20 to d=19. The entry admitted a weight-19 Z-type logical. It is a degree-one r=1 graft of [[563,18,20]], and removing a qubit cannot raise the distance and is not known to preserve it, so the claim had inherited the parent tile value rather than measuring its own; the entry's own bound came from a 20,000-trial search. The over-claim was first reported by @vprusso in the board-wide 2M-trial RIS re-audit of issue #1607; this session reproduced it independently on three fresh-seed rungs at pair depth 64 (2,000,000 / 8,000,000 / 20,000,000 trials, seeds 401/402/403, 30,000,000 trials in total), each returning exactly 19 and none reaching lower; the stored witness is a different weight-19 Z-logical, shifted by two qubits from the one in the issue. The stored witness was re-validated without the search stack: syndrome weight 0 against all 270 H_X rows, and rank(H_Z) 274 -> 275 with it appended, so it lies in ker H_X and outside the stabilizer row space of H_Z. Distance remains a witness-backed upper bound, not an exact claim.
